report.clinical_summary: The patient has been on medication for three years and reports severe functional impairment, with headaches since starting treatment. They feel the illness has 'taken over everything' and that they have 'no say in any of it.' They question whether the medication is worth it, skip doses occasionally, and find taking medication 'another full-time job.' They struggle to connect symptoms to viral load fluctuations and find the illness 'complicated and confusing.' They experience significant worry (described as a 'knot in my stomach') and feel their resilience is 'stretched to its limit.'
